name: car-deals-mcp
description: An MCP server that searches for car deals from Cars.com, Autotrader, and KBB

scripts.test: node -e "const { scrapeCarscom } = require('./src/scraper.js'); scrapeCarscom({ make: 'Toyota', model: 'Camry' }, 3).then(r => r.forEach(l => console.log(l.format())))"
scripts.syntax: node --check src/server.js && node --check src/scraper.js && node --check test/mcp-client.test.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run ec && npm run syntax
